title: Simple collision shapes in robotics.models for Spot, UR5, Panda and the TX2-90L
author: Claude-JG
description: The future trajectory planner needs collision shapes of the robots without STL files. Decided: spheres, capsules or boxes in the link frames, fitted to the collision meshes, for these four robots.
releaseNotes: The UR5, the Panda and the TX2-90L have a capsule per link as collision shape, by urdfImport.FitCapsuleToPoints; GetURDFrobotData(collisionMeshes=True) and ConvexHullOfMesh give the convex hulls of collision meshes and warn about meshes that are not convex.
